brief:
Hundreds of physicians have called on the World Medical Association to suspend Israel's membership, accusing the Israeli Medical Association of failing to speak out against the destruction of Palestinian healthcare, Al Jazeera English reported. The doctors contend that the Israeli medical body has remained silent amid systematic damage to health infrastructure and services in Palestinian territories.

The complaint centers on what the signatories describe as complicity through inaction, with the Israeli Medical Association's silence characterized as enabling continued harm to Palestinian medical facilities and personnel.
dek: Physicians accuse Israeli Medical Association of remaining silent as Palestinian healthcare is systematically destroyed.
title: Hundreds of doctors demand World Medical Association suspend Israel
